reader.requirement: At 85, OPEN of a relative file in any mode (INPUT, I-O, OUTPUT, EXTEND) and any access mode neither reads a record into the record area nor writes one: the first READ after OPEN INPUT/I-O delivers the first record, and an OPEN OUTPUT/EXTEND/I-O closed with no WRITE adds no record.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility (2002+): at 85 every OPEN takes the AllOther file lock and Table 19 is not consulted; no effect on open-mode or position rules

reader.edition-search: grep Edition/IsActive over KeyedConnector.OpenCore, RelativeConnector.Opened and FileConnector.Open: OpenCore only attaches or creates the store and Opened sets the indicator to 1; no record is read or released and no edition is consulted for that.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1_open_no_first_record is a sequential-organization file; relative organization, dynamic access and OPEN I-O are not exercised

probes.printed: IN-FIRST=00 AAA1 (record area set to ZZZZ after OPEN, READ gives record 1); EXTEND and I-O opens closed with no WRITE leave 3 records; dynamic OPEN I-O and INPUT then READ NEXT give AAA1 key 0001; OPEN OUTPUT + CLOSE then READ 10 (MATCH)
probes.expected: 1985 VIII.4.4.4 GR6: OPEN obtains and releases no record

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR6  the text is in the rule (or the clause): "does not obtain or release the first data record"
OK  §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR10  the text is in the rule (or the clause): "the file position indicator is set to 1"

reader.notes: The keyed OPEN body attaches the store and sets the position indicator only; the store is read page by page per statement, so nothing is fetched at OPEN or flushed as a record at CLOSE.

refuter.evidence: r4open-001 at --std 85: OPEN EXTEND of an absent OPTIONAL sequential relative file 05 (created), record area set to ZZZZ, CLOSE, then OPEN INPUT 00 and READ at end 10: nothing released at CLOSE; random OPEN I-O of a file holding record 2, record area ZZZZ and RELATIVE KEY 1, CLOSE, then READ 1 is 23 and READ 2 is 00 RRR2: OPEN/CLOSE released nothing. OPEN EXTEND of a present file then WRITE gives key 0001 (file empty after the first test). cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.4.4.4 GR6 'does not obtain or release the first data record'.
